Subject: External model roles

Cohort or measurement: 24 IDD-AW fog drives, one GPU-resident image per drive; batch one, 512 × 384 to 2048 × 1536
Model or weights: Frozen Mask2Former and SegFormer-B1 with same-grid bilinear, fixed four-scale or original source fit (seed 101). Timing ends at the GPU mask and excludes restoration.

Subject: RGB guide placement on IDD-AW
Cohort or measurement: 146 fog frames/24 drives and 121 mixed-weather drives
Model or weights: Original LiDSeg source coefficients, seeds 101, 211 and 307. Transfer to frozen Mask2Former. RGB and donor placement vary by row.

Subject: Retrospective fixed and fitted kernel comparisons
Cohort or measurement: 146 IDD-AW frames from 24 development drives, screened for visible fog and scored against dense pixel labels, same score grid within each backbone
Model or weights: Original fits are S1-inner/fitted-heads/semantic-subpixel-v94/dual_core-{101,211,307}.pth. Fixed four-scale uses amplitude 6 sigmoid(-0.5) at each scale and spatial exponent 1. The separately trained colour_only, spatial_only and joint arms are recorded in S4/kernel-ablation/source-fit-{101,211,307}.json. Gaussian JBU and bilinear have no fitted checkpoint.

Subject: Matched upsampling operators on the mixed-weather drives
Cohort or measurement: 121 IDD-AW drives, identical frozen Mask2Former grids
Model or weights: Original RGB rule versus fixed JBU and MUSES-fitted DySample and SAPA. The group counts are sufficient for numerical replay.

Subject: Boundary mIoU across BDD100K kernels and weather strata

Subject: Original fit, fixed four-scale rule and matched FeatUp
Cohort or measurement: 128 additional BDD100K training frames; 62 additional IDD-AW fog frames from 16 previously screened drives
Model or weights: S3/decoder.py accepts method raw, fixed, featup or featup-gated. The raw setting is keyed by source seed in design/fixed-evaluation.json. The matched FeatUp weights are weights/featup-{101,211,307}.pth. Aggregate across the three source seeds.

Cohort or measurement: 128 further BDD100K capture prefixes, 768 px, dense native masks
Model or weights: Use original source coefficients and the fixed four-scale rule. For the resolution-specific controls use all 15 MUSES fits in S4/records/training.json (three seeds, five variants). Use the new_bdd panel at 768.

Cohort or measurement: 46 SemanticSTF frames from 11 acquisition dates, 13 mapped classes; near12 and all_points
Model or weights: Frozen original coefficients with both backbones. Use prospective primary projected-point scoring, not the post hoc sparse-sampling bridge.

Subject: Five-knot luminance calibration against a constant blend
Cohort or measurement: Held-out synthetic road views and the six paired photographic cohorts in the table
Model or weights: Keep both RGB heads fixed. The blend curve and the constant control are in the RGB calibration records. Original affine and windowed heads use seeds 32003, 32017 and 32029.

Subject: Frozen road restoration and MCT calibration
Cohort or measurement: BeDDE (208 pairs, 23 city groups) and REVIDE (16 photographs, 8 groups)
Model or weights: Frozen road heads are in S1-inner/fitted-heads/road-transition-v68 and road-tone-control-v98; constants and knot coefficients in data/rgb/coefficients.json. S2/photo-weights.json supplies the held-city calibration for BeDDE and the all-city weights for REVIDE. S2 portable inference defaults to the all-city scalar unless a held-city fold is requested.

Subject: Frozen LiDSeg and matched operators in real fog
Cohort or measurement: 141 distinct Foggy Driving and Foggy Zurich images in the reported cohorts
Model or weights: Source LiDSeg uses the raw-detail adapters and dual_core source fits (seeds 101, 211 and 307). The matched operator records are in data/donors.

Subject: Class weighting inside mixed LiDSeg cells
Cohort or measurement: Fine-labeled mixed cells and the real, synthetic, rain, snow and clear transfer cohorts
Model or weights: Hold source decoder and RGB fixed while changing donor-color weighting. Cell statistics are source diagnostics; target transfers in Sections 5.1–5.6 use uniform donor pooling.

Subject: Paired photographic and semantic responses to haze
Cohort or measurement: 33 clear MUSES frames, 13 recordings; two simulated transmissions per frame
Model or weights: Photographic output uses the deployment seed and fitted luminance curve. Semantic endpoints average three LiDSeg source fits. Resample the same recording IDs for both transmissions.
